---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, new event series, ontology property, or integration for EVENTSKG.
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## 💡 Feature Category
Select the category that best fits your request:
- [ ] **Data Scope**: Adding a new event series, year, or CS/Scientific community
- [ ] **Ontology & Schema**: Requesting new properties, classes, or SEO ontology alignment
- [ ] **Data Formats & Serialization**: New export formats, dumps, or SPARQL features
- [ ] **Tooling & API**: Enhancements to the maintenance API, crawlers, or documentation
- [ ] **Interlinking**: Linking to new external datasets/LOD hubs (e.g., ORKG, Wikidata, DBLP)

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
A clear and concise description of the motivation behind this request (e.g., *"I am trying to analyze venue acceptance trends over time, but the dataset currently lacks..."*).

## ✨ Proposed Feature / Enhancement
A clear description of what you would like to see added or updated in EVENTSKG:
* **Proposed Data/Property**: (e.g., adding submission deadlines, registration fees, h-index, or chair information)
* **Proposed Community/Events**: (e.g., adding top events from Computer Networks or Hardware)

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, workaround scripts, or dataset extensions you have considered.

## 📌 Additional Context & References
Add any other context, sample queries, documentation links, or references that support this feature request.
